Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, without notice and without further payment.
findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the agreement without cause and without paying for work done, leaving you uncompensated if they walk away.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this Agreement upon providing written notice, and the Client shall pay the Contractor for all Services performed up to the effective date of termination.

findings.quoted_text: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable transfer to Client upon delivery.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property rights transfer to the client upon delivery before payment is received, risking your rights if payment is delayed or withheld.
findings.suggested_change: All intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment for such Deliverables.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I would like to propose a couple of adjustments before signing. - Regarding the termination terms, the agreement allows termination without payment for completed work; I propose that either party may terminate upon written notice with payment for services performed. - Regarding the intellectual property transfer, the relevant clause transfers rights upon delivery before payment is received; I propose that rights transfer upon receipt of full payment. Thank you for your time and understanding. Best regards.
